text:
ops-lead: RCA published for the recent cache warmup regression — link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/WarmupRCA :page_facing_up: Please skim summary and add an emoji when you acknowledge.

ops-lead: Short summary: an experimental change to background rehydration timer + an overlapping maintenance window caused sustained cold prefixes and a traffic spike to hit origin. Result: elevated 95/99 latencies and ~45m of elevated error rates for a subset of routes. No customer data exposure.

incident-bot: Incident timeline: detected 1912346000, mitigated 1912348800. Artifacts & heap profiles in doc.

ops-lead: Action items (owner — due):
- flip experimental rehydration flag to off globally if canary shows errors — owner: emma — due: 2026-04-01
- add rollout gating for background timers + alert on rehydration success rate — owner: rafael — due: 2026-04-08
- create short-runbook for validating cache warmup post-deploy (howto + checks) — owner: zane — due: 2026-03-30
- add synthetic traffic job to exercise cold-prefix paths during canaries — owner: product-ops — due: 2026-04-12

emma: ack — turning flag off in canary now, will post PR/ops link.

rafael: noted — drafting alert rules and a gating playbook. will include query examples for rehydration-failure ratio.

zane: I can take the runbook. will add validation steps + quick checklist for oncall.

product-ops: will coordinate synthetic job schedule and tie it to the gating pipeline.

ops-lead: Follow-ups: weekly checkpoint for 3 weeks, first sync 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC (calendar invite sent). Add status updates in the RCA doc under 'Action progress'.

emma: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1499 — revert experiment + added canary-only flag.

rafael: adding telemetry ticket: REDWOOD-8730 with example dashboards.

zane: runbook draft uploaded to doc. please review and leave comments.

ops-lead: Thanks. If you own an item, react with :white_check_mark: and add an ETA. We'll close items in the checkpoints; escalate blockers to me directly.

product-ops: :white_check_mark: scheduled synthetic job for 2026-04-06 02:00 UTC.

ops-lead: Final note: longer-term follow-ups captured under 'postmortem followups' in the doc — includes backpressure during origin bursts and improving cache restoration speed. Eng-runtime to propose mitigations in upcoming RFC.

emma: ack, will monitor canary for 24h and report results.

ops-lead: please react when you've read. thanks everyone. :wave:
